name: Genome, Cell, and Developmental Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official information available. The calendar announces Fall 2027 applications but does not attach a year to the December 1 deadline; it is retained as a published date.

publishedDeadlines.label: Domestic and international PhD application deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Published without an explicit deadline year; confirm the intended entry cycle.

english.note: Minimum recommended scores; tests within two years of application. Unofficial scores for initial review, official scores required to complete the application. Exemptions: citizenship where English is official and/or degree from the US, UK or Canada; other waiver requests go to the program.

applicationFee.note: Biology offers no departmental waivers or reimbursements; central Graduate School categories may apply. Conditional Graduate School waivers cover specified IU recruitment participation, qualifying service, distinguished multiyear fellowships (annual stipend at least $20,000), and some application-status cases. Separate membership/recruitment waivers are US-citizen/permanent-resident only. International applicants should confirm eligibility before applying.

documents: Personal statement, approximately 500 words, on academic/career goals, program fit and qualifications
CV or resume including research, teaching, industry, publications and awards
Transcripts from all undergraduate and graduate programs; international applicants upload unofficial records and provide official documents on admission
Recommender contact information in the application; number of letters not established
Official English test scores unless exempt
requirements.note: Biological-science or related major and laboratory background; exceptions may be considered. GCDB emphasizes faculty fit, research experience, sufficient preparation and communication. Nearly all students rotate through three labs, five weeks each, in the first semester; direct admission is reserved for strong relevant prior research with select faculty. Faculty contact is recommended, not required.

funding.note: All admitted students are promised five full years through fellowships, teaching and research assistantships, with health insurance and free tuition.

timeline.interviews: Overseas applicants interview by video. Invited US-based applicants attend recruitment weekend with travel and lodging paid.
timeline.decisions: Offers usually begin in March; the general calendar lists February–March decisions and April 15 offer acceptance.
